items.title: Relax the id-recency rejection at both review-run binding sites (kind-aware on validate)
items.context: review-run.ts: assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence (~669-672) drop the id-recency throw (write-time, both kinds); validateEvidenceRunBinding (~794-804) keep the stale_run check ONLY for evidence.kind !== 'pass' so open findings still surface but material-fresh non-latest passes become valid. The freshness (674-683/805-822) + scope (691-699/837-857) checks remain the staleness authorities.

happy.desc: Two review_run_start on same lane/round/material, bind pass to run-1 → assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence does NOT throw (write-time acceptance); WHY: validates the id-recency throw removal at write path

Two review_run_start on same lane/round/material, bind pass to run-1 → validateEvidenceRunBinding returns null (no stale_run issue), collectReviewerEvidenceState.invalid is empty; WHY: validates the validate-path relax for kind=pass

edge.desc: Material-drifted non-latest run (materialHash mismatch + storyFilesHash mismatch) → assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence throws stale (freshness authority rejects even though id-recency relaxed); WHY: confirms freshness check is still the staleness authority after id-recency removal
Scope-drifted non-latest run (live scope contract changed) → assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence throws scope mismatch; WHY: confirms scope check is still enforced independently of id-recency
Non-latest run in a DIFFERENT reviewRound → assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence throws wrong_round before id-recency is even checked; WHY: round check precedes id-recency and must still reject

Resolved/dismissed finding bound to non-latest run → collectReviewerEvidenceState supersede filter drops it (does not appear in invalid); WHY: terminal findings are still superseded by the existing filter at L925-929

adversarial.desc: OPEN finding bound to run-1 when run-2 exists on same lane → validateEvidenceRunBinding emits stale_run for that finding (kind-aware: findings keep the stale_run), collectReviewerEvidenceState.invalid includes it; WHY: the KIND-AWARE relax must NOT hide unresolved findings

Attacker mints N sequential run_starts to flush prior findings — each OPEN finding bound to any non-latest run still emits stale_run and blocks; WHY: validates kind-aware invariant holds under repeated run_start churn not just two runs

Pass bound to run-1 AND open finding bound to run-1 on same lane, run-2 exists → pass accepted (no stale_run for pass) but finding still surfaces (stale_run for finding); net result lane blocked; WHY: validates mixed-kind scenario where both evidence types coexist on a superseded run

verificationEvidence.note: B-6c4d smoke creates two same-lane same-round runs and asserts the pass bound to RR-001 is accepted by assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence after RR-002 exists.
B-6c4d smoke writes a pass bound to RR-001 and asserts collectReviewerEvidenceState has no pass stale_run for that non-latest material-fresh run.
B-6c4d smoke commits material drift after the run and asserts the non-latest run hard-rejects as stale, preserving freshness as the staleness authority.
The grep shows both write-time and validate-time paths still compute current scope context and compare the run scope binding, so scope mismatch remains independent of id-recency.
The grep shows run.reviewRound is checked against story.currentReviewRound before the id-recency/currentRun logic, so a different-round run still rejects as wrong_round.
The existing supersede smoke case asserts a resolved stale finding bound to a non-latest run is filtered out of invalid evidence and does not block.
B-6c4d smoke writes an open finding bound to RR-001 while RR-002 exists and asserts collectReviewerEvidenceState includes finding stale_run.
The grep shows currentRunForLane uses the latest run and stale_run is retained for evidence.kind !== pass, so any number of newer run_starts cannot flush open findings.
B-6c4d smoke covers the mixed-kind invariant: pass on RR-001 has no pass stale_run while an open finding on the same non-latest run still surfaces stale_run.

items.title: Add the EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH no-signal guard to checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit
items.context: evidence-freshness.ts drift-advisory branch (~315): the advisory must fire only when BOTH the stored and live storyFilesHash are non-empty (!== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH); an empty-set hash falls through to strict materialHash. Mirrors delivery-check-hash.ts:184-188, generalized for all callers. Soundness prerequisite for the relax.

happy.desc: checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit with materialHash drift + BOTH stored and live storyFilesHash non-empty and matching → returns fresh:true with drift advisory warning; WHY: advisory fires correctly when both hashes carry signal

checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit with materialHash drift + BOTH stored and live storyFilesHash non-empty but MISMATCHING → returns fresh:false (story-owned files changed); WHY: drift advisory does not accept when story files genuinely changed

edge.desc: Stored storyFilesHash === EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH (sha256 of empty string), live non-empty → drift advisory branch skipped, falls through to strict materialHash → fresh:false; WHY: empty stored hash carries no signal, must not enable advisory

Live storyFilesHash === EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH, stored non-empty → drift advisory branch skipped, falls through to strict materialHash → fresh:false; WHY: empty live hash (HEAD==main, no story diff) carries no signal
BOTH stored AND live storyFilesHash === EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH → drift advisory branch skipped, falls through to strict materialHash → fresh:false; WHY: double-empty is the worst no-signal case

evidenceStoryFilesHash is null/undefined (legacy evidence without storyFilesHash) → drift advisory branch skipped entirely (existing guard at L315), falls through to strict materialHash; WHY: backward compatibility with legacy evidence

adversarial.desc: Attacker crafts evidence with storyFilesHash = EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH under whole-tree drift to ride the advisory → guard rejects (falls through to strict materialHash hard-reject); WHY: the exact attack scenario from the pre-mortem — empty-set amplification

Attacker sets storyFilesHash to a near-empty but non-EMPTY value (e.g. sha256 of whitespace) → guard passes it through (it is non-empty), advisory branch compares against live hash which differs → fresh:false (not advisory-accepted); WHY: ensures the guard checks the sentinel specifically, not string-falsy

verificationEvidence.note: Flow smoke asserts matching non-empty storyFilesHash downgrades unrelated whole-tree material drift to fresh:true with a re-attestation warning.
Flow smoke then changes a story-owned file and asserts the same evidence becomes stale, proving mismatching storyFilesHash is not advisory-accepted.
B-6c4d smoke constructs a stored EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH review run under later material drift and asserts it hard-rejects as stale.

verificationEvidence.command: grep -n "evidenceStoryFilesHash && evidenceStoryFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== evidenceStoryFilesHash" packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts
verificationEvidence.note: The grep shows advisory success requires live storyFilesHash to be non-EMPTY and equal; live EMPTY cannot advisory-accept and the mismatch/strict path returns fresh:false.

verificationEvidence.command: grep -n "evidenceStoryFilesHash && evidenceStoryFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== evidenceStoryFilesHash" packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts
verificationEvidence.note: The grep shows both stored and live EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH are excluded from the advisory path, leaving no double-empty acceptance path.

verificationEvidence.command: grep -n "evidenceStoryFilesHash && evidenceStoryFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== evidenceStoryFilesHash" packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts
verificationEvidence.note: The grep shows the advisory is gated by evidenceStoryFilesHash truthiness and non-EMPTY, so null/undefined legacy evidence skips the advisory and remains strict.
B-6c4d smoke directly exercises the empty-set amplification attack by giving the run EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH under material drift and asserting hard reject.

verificationEvidence.command: grep -n "evidenceStoryFilesHash && evidenceStoryFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH\|storyFilesHash && storyFilesHash !== evidenceStoryFilesHash" packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts
verificationEvidence.note: The grep shows the guard excludes only the EMPTY sentinel and then compares any other stored hash to live storyFilesHash, so near-empty non-sentinel values mismatch to fresh:false.

items.title: Add a regression smoke for the binding race and confirm flow-stability semantics hold
items.context: A test that mints two review_run_start on one lane (same round, same material), binds a pass to the FIRST, and asserts it is ACCEPTED (assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence returns; collectReviewerEvidenceState invalid empty) while genuinely material-drifted and empty-signal runs still hard-reject; plus confirm flow-stability-smoke stays green (open finding still blocks via stale_run, superseded pass + resolved finding still drop). Reference /tmp/friction2-runbind-fix/redgreen-spike-test.ts.

happy.desc: Regression smoke: mint two review_run_start on one lane (same round + material), bind pass to FIRST run → assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence returns (no throw), collectReviewerEvidenceState.invalid is empty → smoke PASS; WHY: the primary race-red scenario that triggered this story
flow-stability-smoke.ts (or sibling) runs end-to-end → exit 0 with PASS output; WHY: confirms all existing flow-stability assertions still hold after the relax
npm test (root) exits 0 with no genuine failures; WHY: no regression across the full test suite

edge.desc: Smoke case: genuinely material-drifted run (materialHash changed) with non-latest id → still hard-rejects (collectReviewerEvidenceState.invalid includes stale_run_hash); WHY: relaxing id-recency must not weaken material freshness
Smoke case: empty-set storyFilesHash run under whole-tree drift → still hard-rejects (falls through to strict materialHash, not advisory); WHY: the EMPTY guard from CHK-002 must hold in integration

Smoke case: superseded pass (non-latest run, agent has a valid pass on latest run too) → supersede filter drops the old pass from invalid (no stale_run emitted for it); WHY: existing supersede semantics preserved

adversarial.desc: Smoke case: OPEN finding bound to run-1, run-2 exists → stale_run emitted for the finding, collectReviewerEvidenceState.invalid includes it, lane is blocked; WHY: the kind-aware invariant must hold in the integration smoke — open findings cannot be hidden
Smoke case: resolved finding bound to run-1, run-2 exists → supersede filter drops it from invalid (terminal finding superseded); WHY: resolved findings should not block after the relax

verificationEvidence.note: Regression smoke covers the primary race-red scenario: two same-lane runs, pass bound to first run, assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence returns and invalid pass set stays empty.
The smoke command exited 0 with the PASS output, confirming the flow-stability smoke remains green end to end.
The root npm test command completed with exit 0, covering the full repository test suite with no genuine failures.
Smoke material-drift case hard-rejects the non-latest run after materialHash changes, preserving material freshness under the relaxed id-recency rule.
Smoke empty-set storyFilesHash case hard-rejects under whole-tree drift, proving the EMPTY guard holds in integration.
Existing supersede smoke asserts an older stale pass is dropped when a newer valid pass exists for the same reviewer lane.
Smoke open-finding case asserts stale_run is emitted for an open finding bound to run-1 when a newer run exists, so the lane remains blocked.
Smoke resolved-finding case asserts a resolved stale finding is superseded and absent from invalid evidence after a newer valid pass.

items.title: Reconcile the lease-contract doc and write the decision doc
items.context: docs/requirements/decisions/review-run-binding-race.md (the design decision); reconcile docs .../session-ownership-and-write-leases.md (~101-103) so review_run_start/review_pass_set/finding_add are documented as reviewerWrite / lease-exempt to match command-policy.ts. Doc-only.

happy.desc: review-run-binding-race.md exists and documents: the decision (relax id-recency kind-aware), why id-recency is redundant, the EMPTY guard prerequisite, and rejected alternatives (blanket-relax, lock-unification, keep-strict); WHY: the decision record is the deliverable
session-ownership-and-write-leases.md lists review_run_start, review_pass_set, finding_add as reviewerWrite / lease-exempt matching command-policy.ts; WHY: doc-code consistency is the deliverable

edge.desc: session-ownership-and-write-leases.md reclassifies review_run_start / review_pass_set / finding_add as reviewerWrite / lease-exempt with NO stale lease-required wording left behind → grep both the doc and command-policy.ts, classifications agree exactly; WHY: partial reconciliation leaving contradictory wording is worse than no change

review-run-binding-race.md rejected-alternatives section lists ALL four options from decision.json (relax-kind-aware, keep-strict, unify-lock-only, blanket-relax-without-guard) with rationale for each rejection; WHY: an incomplete rejected-alternatives list undermines the decision record

adversarial.desc: review-run-binding-race.md must NOT contradict docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md — it must not claim the EMPTY guard changes the adopted-bindings list, relaxes any other gate, or modifies delivery-check behavior; WHY: the decision doc must be scoped to id-recency only and not over-claim into adjacent specs

session-ownership-and-write-leases.md edit must NOT grant a lease to any command that command-policy.ts marks as lease-exempt — no over-claim that would weaken the lease model; grep for lease-exempt commands in command-policy.ts and verify none are listed as lease-required in the doc; WHY: an over-grant in docs could mislead future implementers into adding unnecessary lease acquisition

verificationEvidence.note: The grep shows the decision doc exists and documents id-recency relaxation, kind-aware behavior, EMPTY guard prerequisite, and alternatives context.
The grep shows the lease contract doc has a reviewerWrite section documenting reviewer evidence writes as lease-exempt.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const d=fs.readFileSync('docs/requirements/decisions/session-ownership-and-write-leases.md','utf8'); const c=fs.readFileSync('packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts','utf8'); for (const x of ['review_run_start','review_pass_set','finding_add']) { if (!d.includes(x)) throw new Error('doc missing '+x); if (!c.includes(x+':') && !c.includes(x)) throw new Error('policy missing '+x); } if (!d.includes('reviewerWrite')) throw new Error('doc missing reviewerWrite'); if (d.includes('lease-required')) throw new Error('stale lease-required wording'); console.log('reviewerWrite lease doc matches command policy')"
verificationEvidence.note: The read-only assertion checks review_run_start, review_pass_set, and finding_add are in the doc and command-policy, reviewerWrite is present, and stale lease-required wording is absent.
The grep shows the chosen Decision section plus rejected alternatives for keep-strict, unify-lock-A alone, and blanket relax without the EMPTY/kind-aware guard.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const race=fs.readFileSync('docs/requirements/decisions/review-run-binding-race.md','utf8'); const drift=fs.readFileSync('docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md','utf8'); if (!race.includes('id-recency')) throw new Error('missing id-recency scope'); if (!race.includes('EMPTY_STORY_FILES_HASH')) throw new Error('missing EMPTY guard'); if (!drift.includes('storyFilesHash') || !drift.includes('delivery-check')) throw new Error('baseline drift doc missing expected scope'); for (const phrase of ['adopted bindings','relaxes any other gate','modifies delivery-check behavior']) if (race.includes(phrase)) throw new Error('overclaim: '+phrase); console.log('review-run binding doc is scoped to id-recency and EMPTY guard')"
verificationEvidence.note: The read-only assertion checks the binding-race doc is scoped to id-recency and EMPTY guard, references the baseline storyFilesHash/delivery-check doc, and lacks forbidden overclaim phrases.

verificationEvidence.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const d=fs.readFileSync('docs/requirements/decisions/session-ownership-and-write-leases.md','utf8'); const c=fs.readFileSync('packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts','utf8'); for (const x of ['review_run_start','review_pass_set','finding_add']) { if (!d.includes(x)) throw new Error('doc missing '+x); if (!c.includes(x+':') && !c.includes(x)) throw new Error('policy missing '+x); } if (!d.includes('reviewerWrite')) throw new Error('doc missing reviewerWrite'); if (d.includes('lease-required')) throw new Error('stale lease-required wording'); console.log('reviewerWrite lease doc matches command policy')"
